messages:
Elena M: Opening a small PR: 'Dedicated provisioning quickstart (lite)' 1 page quickstart, autoscale YAML, and a one-paragraph SLA appendix. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2115
Jared H: love the one-pager idea. please keep the autoscale example minimal and call out that cooldowns are per-pool.
Elena M: will do. question: use `tenant_label` key or `tenant_selector` in examples? Runtime accepts both but docs should be clear.
Ash K: prefer `tenant_label` for examples (matches onboarding flow). add a short note that labels must follow the registry pattern and link to the tenant registry doc.
Elena M: added note + link to registry. Autoscale snippet now: `scalePolicy: minReplicas:1 maxReplicas:6 cooldownSeconds:360 metric:requests_per_second` (inline to keep mobile-friendly).
Jared H: tiny nit: call out KV cache warmup affects first-minute latency. Also in SLA appendix, make the reserved vs burst distinction explicit but short.
Elena M: added KV cache note and updated appendix: 'Reserved: stable capacity, low preemption risk. Burst: opportunistic capacity, may be preempted under cluster pressure.'
Docs Bot: Reminder: add changelog entry and nav label.
Elena M: changelog added, nav label set to 'Dedicated quickstart'. Ready for review @Jared @Ash
Jared H: reviewed, two copy edits pushed. :thumbsup:
Ash K: approved. Shipping. Follow-up: create a separate PR for Terraform snippet and expanded metrics recommendations.
Elena M: merged. thanks everyone!
